scoring_justification: Main transport properties (load-bearing) are T0 result-level compare against paper-reported values with generous tolerances; DOS and bandgap use T3 structural checks because exact DFT values are implementation-dependent. T1 recompute is infeasible in the verifier (cannot re-run DFT).

outputs.description: Spin-polarized density of states at the Fermi level. Majority spin should be non-zero; minority spin should be near zero.
Band gap (eV) for the minority spin channel.
Transport coefficients at 300 K: Seebeck coefficient and electrical conductivity per relaxation time at the Fermi level, maximum Seebeck coefficient and its chemical potential location.

output_contract.notes: All output files must be placed under /app/outputs. The DFT process step must be executed by the agent; no precomputed charge density is provided. Verifier will check structural properties (sign, approximate magnitude) for DOS and gap, and compare transport values to hidden references.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference values for transport properties and structural thresholds for DOS/bandgap
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper (CrystEngComm 2013, DOI:10.1039/c3ce40643a): Fig. 3 shows Seebeck ~150 µV/K at EF (majority spin, p-type), σ/τ ~10^13 S/(cm·s) at EF, maximum Seebeck ~1186 µV/K at 0.07 eV above EF. DOS: majority spin has non-zero DOS at EF, minority spin has zero DOS at EF (gap). Band gap ~0.4 eV from diffuse reflectance and consistent with DFT PDOS.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values extracted from paper text and figures: Seebeck_max=1186 µV/K and Seebeck_max_mu=0.07 eV stated explicitly in Results and Discussion section. σ/τ derived from reported σ≈0.1 S/cm with τ~10⁻¹⁴ s → 10¹³ S/(cm·s). Seebeck_at_EF≈150 µV/K estimated from Fig. 3 (majority spin at EF). Band gap ~0.4 eV from experimental measurement. DOS structural expectations from PDOS description (Fig. 2).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: All values trace to specific paper-reported numbers (text statements or figures). Tolerances are generous to accommodate different DFT implementations (Quantum ESPRESSO vs VASP, different pseudopotentials, k-point sampling).

steps.description: Check majority spin DOS > 0 at EF and minority spin DOS near zero
Check minority spin band gap is positive and in plausible range
Compare transport properties to paper-reported values with generous tolerances
